purpose: Approved D04 three-group concept review; no production asset or Owner acceptance credit
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Hearthward TASK-070 approved visual-direction review, concept illustration only. A grounded fictional ancient woodland community with stone tools and small metal cutting edges, timber upper structures and rough stone foundations. Muted wood brown, pale stone grey, grass green, ochre, restrained reddish brown. Realistic game-ready PBR appearance, clear restrained forms, woven rough cloth, matte leather, wood grain and fibrous rope, metal bright only at cutting edges. Fictional abstract woven geometry only. No identifiable historical dynasty, region, real-world ethnicity, religious symbols, modern objects, magical effects, glossy plastic, plate-knight armor, ornate fantasy costume, UI, logos, text or watermark. Show readable silhouettes and functional material separation. Wide high-resolution landscape composition, avoid tiny details or unreadable mini-panels.
Primary request: one full-body character outfit and silhouette reference sheet: elder protagonist brother, slightly smaller adult companion brother, and an ordinary protected community resident. Reference images 1 and 2 are existing UE test views and provide adult body proportions only; do not reproduce the test room, bent animation pose, UI strip or old plate-like outfits. Place the three adults standing naturally side by side at the same camera depth, feet fully visible, restrained expressions, simple plain neutral warm grey background, soft neutral daylight. Keep realistic existing adult anatomy rather than exaggerated redesigns. Elder: subdued reddish-brown rough cloth with functional leather forearm protection, rope belt, stone-and-bone axe lowered at side. Companion: olive ochre cloth layers, smaller simple bag, leather wrist wraps, restrained stone tool. Resident: pale grey woven tunic with brown work apron and compact gathering basket. Make cloth color and shoulder silhouettes distinct without labels. Show believable grips with fingers around the handles and no intersections. Metal should remain a small functional accent.

Primary request: one coherent camp architecture and working-station material concept scene, a low timber shelter with rough stone base, wooden plank and grass-covered roof, rope lashings, broad unobstructed door. Clearly show four distinct usable stations outside: woodworking bench with timber and hand tools, modest clay furnace with dark fire opening, stone-based forging station with small anvil and a few metal tools, cooking hearth with simple pot. At one edge include functional wooden storage and a simple sheltered bed. Space everything for a normal adult to stand at the working side; show one small adult silhouette for scale. Human-height timber structures, modest practical construction, no grand hall or castle. Three-quarter human-eye camera, clear full scene, soft afternoon daylight, believable separate wood/stone/clay/cloth surfaces. This is a materials and silhouette study, not a new gameplay ground plan.

Primary request: one large environment mood comparison diptych for terrain and hometown, two equally readable wide views, no written labels. Left half: same woodland material direction with warm camp fire at twilight, timber hut with stone footings, brown earthen main path leading toward a clearly outlined riverbank crossing and small timber landing, grass green and soft orange firelight. Right half: an occupied hometown approach in cold grey-blue dusk with restrained low timber buildings on stone footings, darker subdued ground and cool mist behind the structures. Keep the foreground road, entrances and standing human silhouettes distinctly readable in both halves; darkness must not swallow the player route. Atmosphere is layered and quiet, not a flood of volumetric fog or bloom. Keep the same grounded material language, human scale and fictional woodland architecture across both sides.
